sql:
SELECT cls, fished_date_doy, AVG(yt::FLOAT / NULLIF(anglers, 0)) as avg_yt_angler, COUNT(*) as boats, SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy >= 32 AND fished_date_doy <= 135
GROUP BY cls, fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, avg_yt_angler DESC
LIMIT 80
